parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 11:00 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 11:00 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
At 825 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain have
fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Marquez, Cebolletita, Seboyeta, Bibo, Paguate and Encinal.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly or mountainous terrain there are numerous low water
crossings which are potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 12:00 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 12:00 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Gila County in east central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until midnight MST.

* At 719 PM MST, river gauges on Fossil Creek indicated that flood
waters were receding in the upper portions of Fossil Creek.
Portions of Fossil Creek closer to the Verde River are still
running high.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Gila and Yavapai Counties.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Hardscrabble Creek, Verde River and Fossil Creek.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable.

flooded as well.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Graham County in southeastern Arizona...
Central Greenlee County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 800 PM MST.

* At 550 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Clifton, Morenci, York, Guthrie and Three Way.

This includes the following highways...
Route 78 between mile markers 155 and 167. Route 191 between mile
markers 132 and 179. Route 75 between mile markers 396 and 398. Route
70 between mile markers 350 and 354.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Ward Canyon Rd.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 7:15 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 7:15 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
At 545 PM MST, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms producing
heavy rain in Stockholm Wash resulting in water running over several
local roadways near Safford and Solomon. Between 1 and 3 inches of
rain have fallen. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Safford, Solomon, San Jose, Safford Regional Airport and Swift
Trail Junction.

This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 98 and 113...and between mile markers
131 and 132. Route 70 between mile markers 340 and 350. Route 266
between mile markers 105 and 112.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 5:15 PM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 5:15 PM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* Until 515 PM MST.

* At 446 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 13 miles south of Linden, or 14 miles southwest of Show
Low, moving north at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and tennis ball size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Show Low, Taylor, White Mountain Lake Estates, Linden, Pinedale,
Shumway, Taylor Airport, Red Top Mountain, Fool Hollow Lake, Ned
Lake, Telephone Lake, Pintail Lake and Schoens Lake.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 327 and 336. Highway 60 between
mile markers 322 and 340. State Route 77 between mile markers 346 and
356.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Fool Hollow Lake Recreation Area Campground and Lewis Canyon Group
Campground.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 4:13PM MST until October 22 at 7:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 7:15 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 7:15 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Graham County in southeastern Arizona...
Central Greenlee County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 715 PM MST.

* At 413 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Clifton, Morenci, York, Guthrie and Three Way.

This includes the following highways...
Route 78 between mile markers 155 and 167. Route 191 between mile
markers 132 and 179. Route 75 between mile markers 396 and 398. Route
70 between mile markers 350 and 354.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Ward Canyon Rd.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 5:00 PM MDT. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 5:00 PM MDT. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.senderName: NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
info.description:
TOREPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Central Grant County in southwestern New Mexico...
North central Hidalgo County in southwestern New Mexico...

* Until 500 PM MDT.

* At 427 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 9 miles southeast of Redrock, moving north at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This tornadic thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
central Grant and north central Hidalgo Counties, including the
following locations... Gila Middle Box.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 645 PM MDT.

* At 341 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms moving into
Zion National Park from the south. Up to 0.25 inches of rain have
fallen from previous showers over the last half hour. Additional
rainfall amounts up to 0.75 inches are possible across the park as
these thunderstorms move in. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, creeks and streams

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park and Springdale.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to slot canyons, normally dry washes, creeks and
streams which can become killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers
should avoid streams or creeks.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:30 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:30 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Paria River in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 830 PM MST /930 PM MDT/ Tonight.

* At 226 PM MST /326 PM MDT/, repeated heavy rainfall from
thunderstorms across the region have caused a nearly 6 foot rise on
the Paria River, with additional rises reported well upstream.
Levels are falling at Lees Ferry, but are expected to rise again
later this afternoon and evening. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Paria River.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lees Ferry and Vermilion Cliffs National Monument.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River and Paria River.
info.instruction:
Get out of the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters will continue to
flow down the Paria River.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 815 PM MST Thursday.

* At 209 PM MST, repeated heavy rainfall from thunderstorms across
the region have caused a nearly 6 foot rise in Oak Creek at Sedona.
Water levels are still rising. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sedona, Cornville, Jordan, Page Springs, Indian Gardens, Pine
Flats, Uptown Sedona, Red Rock State Park, Slide Rock State Park,
West Fork of Oak Creek, Red Rock-Secret Mountain Wilderness,
Cathedral Rock, East Pocket Lookout Tower and Oak Creek Vista
Overlook.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 179 between mile markers 311 and 313. State Route 89A
between mile markers 374 and 393.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Manzanita Campground, Pine Flat Campground, Cave Springs Campground
and Windmill Park.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Pumphouse Wash, Slide Rock, Encinoso, Grasshopper Point, Midgely
Bridge, Buddha Beach "Red Rock Crossing", Crescent Moon Ranch and
Mormons Crossing.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Dry Creek, Oak Creek, West Fork Oak Creek, Turkey Creek, Spring
Creek, Pumphouse Wash and Verde River.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 2:05PM MST until October 22 at 8:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Gila County in east central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 800 PM MST.

* At 205 PM MST, repeated heavy rainfall from thunderstorms across
the region have caused a nearly 8 foot rise in Fossil Creek. Flash
flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
The Toilet Bowl and Fossil Springs Wilderness.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes and waterfalls on Fossil Creek and Fossil Creek
Dam "The Toilet Bowl".

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Hardscrabble Creek, Verde River and Fossil Creek.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 3:15 PM MDT. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORABQ

The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southwestern Sandoval County in north central New Mexico...
Northeastern Cibola County in west central New Mexico...
East Central McKinley County in west central New Mexico...

* Until 315 PM MDT.

* At 239 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Cebolletita, or 12 miles north of Laguna Pueblo,
moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Marquez, Cebolletita, Seboyeta, Bibo, Paguate and Encinal.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...
Apache County in northeastern Arizona...

* Until 130 PM MST.

* At 107 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 5 miles southeast of McNary, or 15 miles northeast of
Whiteriver, moving northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Hawley Lake, Cyclone Lake, Earl Park Lake and Horseshoe Cienega
Lake.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 363 and 372. State Route 473
between mile markers 0 and 10.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Los Burros Campground and Los Burros Campground.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.headline: Observed and expected Flooding in Cibola County

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: County-wide flooding! Never cross low-water crossings. Turn Around, Don't Drown! Stay safe

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: Flood Warning: Flooding may create hazardous conditions throughout the county. Never cross flooded roads or low-water crossings. Watch for rising water, debris, and washouts. Follow closures and emergency instructions. Turn Around, Don't Drown! Stay alert and share this warning.

info.description: FLOOD WARNING FOR THE ENTIRE COUNTY Attention Residents: There is flooding across the county causing hazardous conditions. Heavy rain can lead to quickly rising water, dangerous roads, and sudden flash floods.DO NOT CROSS LOW-WATER AREAS!Do not drive, walk, or try to cross flooded roads. If you see water over the road, TURN AROUND AND FIND ANOTHER WAY. Watch out for rising water, washed-out roads, and debris. Stay away from flooded areas and follow road closure signs and emergency personnel directions. Remember: TURN AROUND, DON'T DROWN! Even a small amount of moving water can move a car or sweep away a person.Stay informed, be careful, and share this warning with others to keep everyone safe.Your safety is our priority. DO NOT TAKE UNNECESSARY RISKS.
info.instruction: Residents are urged to prepare for possible flooding, stay alert, and monitor changing conditions. Watch local news stations and official emergency alerts for updates. Be ready to take action if conditions worsen. Never cross flooded roads or low-water crossings. Turn Around, Don't Drown! Stay safe and be prepared!

parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 1:00 PM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 1:00 PM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...
Apache County in northeastern Arizona...

* Until 100 PM MST.

* At 1235 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a
tornado was located 6 miles north of Pinetop-Lakeside, or 5 miles
east of Show Low, moving northeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and ping pong ball size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Show Low, White Mountain Lake Estates, Mesa Redonda and Porter
Mountain Outlook.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 near mile marker 345. Highway 60 between mile markers
344 and 353. State Route 61 between mile markers 353 and 354.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 12:31PM MDT until October 22 at 3:30PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 3:30 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 3:30 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern San Miguel County in southwestern Colorado...
Southeastern Montrose County in west central Colorado...

* Until 330 PM MDT.

* At 1231 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Heavy
rainfall rates are occurring on already saturated ground as this
area has received between 1 and 2 inches of rain over the last 24
hours. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Norwood, Sawpit, Placerville and Fall Creek.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Highway 145 between Norwood and Sawpit is prone to rockslides and
mudslides in heavy rain. Stay alert for rocks and debris on roads,
and avoid driving on flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

saturated area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin

deaths occur in vehicles.

is prone to rockslides and mudslides in heavy rain. Stay alert for
rocks and debris on roads, and avoid driving on flooded roads. Find
an alternate route.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 11:40AM MDT until October 22 at 3:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 3:45 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 3:45 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 345 PM MDT.

* At 1140 AM MDT, Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen across
the headwaters of Gould Wash from earlier thunderstorms which
created a large flood wave which continues to move through
Hurricane. Additional thunderstorms forming to the south and west
are expected to move back into this area exacerbating the flooding
within the next 30 to 45 minutes. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Gould Wash through Hurricane.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

info.headline: Required Weekly Test
info.description:
This is a required weekly test of the Emergency Alert System, originating from the Michigan State Police State Emergency Operations Center in Lansing.  
 
If this had been an actual emergency, such as a tornado, toxic material release, nuclear plant incident, widespread phone or power outages, or other state or local emergency that affects your safety, official messages would have followed the alert tone.

 
This concludes this test of the Emergency Alert System.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 22 at 9:30AM MST until October 22 at 10:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 10:00 AM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 10:00 AM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 1000 AM MST.

* At 930 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Village of Oak Creek, or 6 miles south of Sedona,
moving north at 55 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Sedona and Red Rock State Park.

This includes State Route 89A between mile markers 365 and 371.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Crescent Moon Ranch.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 22 at 9:30AM MST until October 22 at 10:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: SNM:AVISO DE TORNADO hasta las 10:00 AM MST. Refugiese ahora. Consulte medios informativos

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: Servicio Nacional de Meteorologia: AVISO DE TORNADO en efecto hasta las 10:00 AM MST. Busque refugio ahora en un sotano o en el interior de un cuarto en el nivel mas bajo de un edificio seguro. Si esta al aire libre, en una casa movil, o en un vehiculo, debe ir al edificio seguro mas cercano y protegerse de proyectiles. Consulte los medios informativos.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 9:52AM MDT until October 22 at 11:45AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 11:45 AM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 11:45 AM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 1145 AM MDT.

* At 952 AM MDT, Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen across
the headwaters of Gould Wash, and a large flood wave is moving
downstream through Hurricane. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Gould Wash through Hurricane.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 7:19AM MST until October 22 at 8:00AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ

parameter.name: NWSheadline
parameter.value: FLASH FLOOD WARNING FOR THE SYCAMORE BURN SCAR REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 AM MST THIS MORNING FOR GILA COUNTY

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:00 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:00 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
At 719 AM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain over the Sycamore Burn Scar. Up to 1.25 inches of rain have
fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Sycamore Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Sycamore Burn Scar.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Gila County.
info.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Sycamore Burn Scar. Severe debris flows can also be
anticipated across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in
places. If you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 8:16AM MDT until October 22 at 10:15AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT

parameter.name: NWSheadline
parameter.value: FLASH FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1015 AM MDT THIS MORNING FOR SOUTHEASTERN WASHINGTON COUNTY

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 10:15 AM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 10:15 AM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
At 816 AM MDT, Emergency management reported Highway 59 between
Hurricane and Apple Valley due to flooding. Doppler radar indicated
between 0.75 and 1.25 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall
amounts of 0.25 to 0.5 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash
flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
La Verkin and Virgin.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

info.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern San Juan County in southeastern Utah...

* Until 1115 AM MDT.

* At 810 AM MDT, Local law enforcement reported heavy rain across the
warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Additional
rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the warned area.
Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain and
thunderstorms producing flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Southeastern San Juan County.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 7:31AM MDT until October 22 at 10:30AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 10:30 AM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 10:30 AM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Iron County in southern Utah...
Northwestern Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 1030 AM MDT.

* At 731 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.25 and 0.5 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park, Apple Valley, Springdale, Kanarraville and
Rockville.

This includes Interstate 15 between mile markers 43 and 47, as well
as Kanarraville Falls.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 7:16AM MDT until October 22 at 10:15AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 10:15 AM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 10:15 AM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 1015 AM MDT.

* At 716 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 0.75 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
La Verkin and Virgin.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

info.description:
FFWPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Sycamore Burn Scar in...
Gila County in east central Arizona...

* Until 800 AM MST.

* At 455 AM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Sycamore Burn Scar. Up to 0.75 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
expected within the next half hour in the warned area. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Sycamore Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Sycamore Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Gila County.
info.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Sycamore Burn Scar. Severe debris flows can also be
anticipated across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in
places. If you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 12:21AM MST until October 22 at 8:15AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:15 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:15 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Apache County in northeastern Arizona...

* Until 915 AM MDT Thursday.

* At 121 AM MDT, a river gauge on Chine Creek within Canyon de Chelly
National Monument reported a rapid rise above flood stage from
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Flash
flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of Chine Creek.

* For Chinle Creek at Chinle:
At 1:00am the stage was 4.1 feet.
Flood Stage is 4.0 feet.
Impacts:
At 3.6 feet: Chinle Creek becomes impassable to recreational
vehicles.
At 4.0 feet: Water begins to encroach upon structures just upstream
of the Highway 64 bridge near the Canyon de Chelly welcome center.
At 4.3 feet: Flooding to homes and residences in Chinle on left
bank downstream from Highway 64 bridge.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Chinle, Canyon De Chelly National Monument and Mummy Cave Overlook.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Junction Overlook, White House Overlook, Antelope House Overlook and
Face Rock Overlook.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Chinle Wash, Coyote Wash, Muerto, Canyon del, Sheep Dip Creek,
Black Rock Canyon and Nazlini Wash.
info.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

info.description:
FFWLOX

The National Weather Service in Los Angeles/Oxnard has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Santa Barbara County in southwestern California...

* Until 200 AM PDT.

* At 1014 PM PDT, gauge reports indicated thunderstorms producing
increasingly heavy rain across the warned area. The expected
rainfall rate is 1 to 1.5 inches in 1 hour. Dangerous flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly, dangerous rock
slides and mud slides are also expected.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding. Dangerous rock slides and mud slides.

SOURCE...Gauges reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Santa Barbara, Montecito, Carpinteria and Summerland.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 9:49PM MST until October 22 at 2:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 2:00 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 2:00 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Moenkopi Wash in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 200 AM MST /300 AM MDT/.

* At 949 PM MST /1049 PM MDT/, Moenkopi Wash remained above major
flood stage, with only a gradual decrease over the last hour. With
additional heavy rain expected in the Moenkopi Wash basin, flooding
is expected to continue. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Moenkopi Wash.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Moenkopi Wash.

* For Moenkopi Wash near Tuba City:
At 8:45pm MST /9:45pm MDT/ the stage was 33.54 feet.
Flood Stage is 27.0 feet.
Impacts:
At 27.0 feet: At 27.0 feet water begins to encroach on homes in
lower Moenkopi Village and floods crop fields along the river.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Moenkopi.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Hamblin Wash, Begashibito Wash, Little Colorado River, Moenkopi
Wash and Fivemile Wash.
info.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 2:30 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 2:30 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 230 AM MST /330 AM MDT/ Tonight.

* At 827 PM MST /927 PM MDT/, a river gauge on the Little Colorado
River near the Colorado River reported a rapid rise of 5 feet from
thunderstorms earlier today. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to
1 inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Colorado River Navajo Tribal Park and Salt Trail Canyon.

This includes the following highways...
the Colorado River near mile marker 62. State Route 64 near mile
marker 282...and between mile markers 285 and 286.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Blue Water Base Camp, Old Fish Camp Site and Above LCR Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Blue Water Base Camp.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Bekihatso Wash, Colorado River, Little Colorado River, Moenkopi
Wash and Sheep Wash.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 7:30 PM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* Until 730 PM MST.

* At 702 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Heber-Overgaard, moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and half dollar size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Heber-Overgaard, Aripine, Mogollon Airpark and Twin Lake.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 299 and 313. State Route 377
between mile markers 0 and 13. State Route 277 between mile markers
306 and 319.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Tall Timbers County Park.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* Until 645 PM MST.

* At 620 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 7 miles northwest of Forest Lakes, or 19 miles west of
Heber-Overgaard, moving northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Durfee Crossing, Chevelon Canyon Lake and Chevelon Canyon Dam.

This includes State Route 260 between mile markers 300 and 303.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Chevelon Canyon Lake Campground, Forest Road 237 Camping Area and
Camp Shadow Pines.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 9:45 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 9:45 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 945 PM MDT.

* At 642 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain along the Santa Clara River. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of
rain has fallen. Additional thunderstorms are possible over the
next couple hours. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding along the Santa Clara
River, with additional impacts to urban areas, highways,
streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Santa Clara and Ivins.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

parameter.name: NWSheadline
parameter.value: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 530 PM MST FOR SOUTHEASTERN GRAHAM COUNTY

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS:DESTRUCTIVE HAIL STORM in this area til 530 PM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING in effect for this area until 5:30 PM MST for DESTRUCTIVE baseball size hail. Take shelter in a sturdy building, away from windows. People and animals outdoors will be severely injured.

info.description:
At 449 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Roper Lake
State Park, moving northeast at 30 mph.

THIS IS A DESTRUCTIVE STORM FOR SWIFT TRAIL JUNCTION AND SOLOMON.

HAZARD...Baseball size hail and 70 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be severely injured. Expect
shattered windows, extensive damage to roofs, siding, and
vehicles.

Locations impacted include...
Safford, Thatcher, Solomon, San Jose, Roper Lake State Park,
Safford Regional Airport and Swift Trail Junction.

This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 102 and 140. Route 70 between mile
markers 338 and 365. Route 266 between mile markers 105 and 110.
info.instruction:
Seek shelter now inside an interior room on the lowest floor of a
well-built structure. This storm is capable of producing destructive
hail and widespread damaging winds.

Tornadoes can develop quickly from severe thunderstorms. Seek shelter
immediately in an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built
structure.

parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 7:45 PM PDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 7:45 PM PDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWVEF

The National Weather Service in Las Vegas has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Inyo County in south central California...
San Bernardino County in southern California...

* Until 745 PM PDT.

* At 446 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Furnace Creek.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

The Moenkopi Wash in... Coconino County in north central Arizona... * Until 1000 PM MST /1100 PM MDT/. * At 431 PM MST /531 PM MDT/, a river gauge on the Moenkopi Wash remains in Major Flood Stage. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly. HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing flash flooding in and around the Moenkopi Wash. SOURCE...River gauge reported. IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the Moenkopi Wash. * For Moenkopi Wash at Moenkopi Wash Near Tuba City: At 1:45pm MST /2:45pm MDT/ the stage was 31.82 feet. Flood Stage is 27.0 feet. Forecast: A crest of 30.97 feet is expected at 3:00pm MST /4:00pm MDT/ Wednesday. Impacts: At 27.0 feet: At 27.0 feet water begins to encroach on homes in lower Moenkopi Village and floods crop fields along the river. Some locations that will experience flash flooding include... Tuba City and Moenkopi. This includes the following highways... Highway 160 between mile markers 318 and 321. U.S. Highway 89 between mile markers 476 and 478. info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 4:31PM MST until October 21 at 10:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 10:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 10:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Moenkopi Wash in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 1000 PM MST /1100 PM MDT/.

* At 431 PM MST /531 PM MDT/, a river gauge on the Moenkopi Wash
remains in Major Flood Stage. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen.
Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Moenkopi Wash.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Moenkopi Wash.

* For Moenkopi Wash at Moenkopi Wash Near Tuba City:
At 1:45pm MST /2:45pm MDT/ the stage was 31.82 feet.
Flood Stage is 27.0 feet.
Forecast: A crest of 30.97 feet is expected at 3:00pm MST /4:00pm
MDT/ Wednesday.
Impacts:
At 27.0 feet: At 27.0 feet water begins to encroach on homes in
lower Moenkopi Village and floods crop fields along the river.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tuba City and Moenkopi.

This includes the following highways...
Highway 160 between mile markers 318 and 321. U.S. Highway 89 between
mile markers 476 and 478. State Route 264 between mile markers 323
and 324.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Moenkopi Wash, Little Colorado River, Hamblin Wash, Begashibito
Wash and Fivemile Wash.
info.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Moenkopi Wash. Severe debris flows can also be anticipated
across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in places. If
you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 4:18PM MST until October 21 at 8:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:30 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:30 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 830 PM MST /930 PM MDT/.

* At 418 PM MST /518 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch
of rain has fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Colorado River Navajo Tribal Park and Salt Trail Canyon.

This includes the following highways...
the Colorado River near mile marker 62. State Route 64 near mile
marker 282...and between mile markers 285 and 286.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Blue Water Base Camp, Old Fish Camp Site and Above LCR Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Blue Water Base Camp.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Moenkopi Wash, Sheep Wash, Colorado River, Little Colorado River
and Bekihatso Wash.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 21 at 4:02PM MST until October 21 at 4:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 4:45 PM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 4:45 PM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
South Central Graham County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 445 PM MST.

* At 402 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 19 miles northwest of Willcox, moving northeast at 30
mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and ping pong ball size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Fort Grant, Bonita, Mount Graham and Frye Mesa Dam.

This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 107 and 112. Route 266 between mile
markers 111 and 126.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:00 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Iron County in southern Utah...
West Central Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 800 PM MDT.

* At 501 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across Zion Canyon within Zion National Park. Up to 0.25
inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to
0.75 inches are possible in the warned area with this current
storm, and additional thunderstorms remain likely over the next
several hours. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, creeks, and streams.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park, Springdale and Rockville.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 7:45 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 7:45 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 745 PM MDT.

* At 455 PM MDT, The USGS gage on Fort Pearce Wash has reported a
rise of roughly 5 feet due to runoff from heavy rain due to earlier
thunderstorms. Between 0.25 and 0.75 inches of rain previously
fell. This flood wave will continue downstream to its confluence
with the Virgin River. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Gauges reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of normally dry washes...
specifically Fort Pearce Wash.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Fort Pearce Wash.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS:DESTRUCTIVE HAIL STORM in this area til 345 PM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING in effect for this area until 3:45 PM MST for DESTRUCTIVE baseball size hail. Take shelter in a sturdy building, away from windows. People and animals outdoors will be severely injured.

info.description:
At 334 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located over Metro Center,
or near Phoenix, moving northeast at 40 mph.

THIS IS A DESTRUCTIVE STORM FOR CENTRAL PORTIONS OF PHOENIX.

HAZARD...Baseball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be severely injured. Expect
shattered windows, extensive damage to roofs, siding, and
vehicles.

Locations impacted include...
Phoenix, Glendale, Sun City, Deer Valley Airport, North Mountain
Park, Metro Center, Piestewa Peak Park, Desert Ridge Marketplace,
Arrowhead Mall, Downtown Glendale and Downtown Peoria.

This includes the following highways...
AZ Route 101 between mile markers 10 and 15...and between mile
markers 17 and 18...and near mile marker 19. US Highway 60 between
mile markers 149 and 158. AZ Interstate 17 between mile markers 203
and 212. AZ Route 51 between mile markers 10 and 15...and between
mile markers 3 and 6. AZ Interstate 10 near mile marker 146. AZ Route
303 between mile markers 138 and 139.
info.instruction:
Seek shelter now inside an interior room on the lowest floor of a
well-built structure. This storm is capable of producing destructive
hail and damaging winds.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 21 at 3:29PM MST until October 21 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 4:00 PM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 4:00 PM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...
Apache County in northeastern Arizona...

* Until 400 PM MST.

* At 329 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Wagon Wheel, or 6 miles southwest of Show Low,
moving northeast at 50 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Show Low, Taylor, Pinetop-Lakeside, Lake of the Woods, White
Mountain Lake Estates, Linden, Wagon Wheel, Shumway, Vernon,
Rainbow Lake, Show Low Regional Airport, Show Low Lake, Mesa
Redonda, White Mountain Lake Airport, Pintail Lake, Telephone Lake,
Ned Lake, Porter Mountain Outlook, Fool Hollow Lake and Red Top
Mountain.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 331 and 350. Highway 60 between
mile markers 327 and 365. State Route 61 between mile markers 353 and
361. State Route 77 between mile markers 343 and 353.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Scott Reservoir Campground, Fool Hollow Lake Recreation Area
Campground and Lakeside Campground.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Report severe weather to your nearest law enforcement agency or the
National Weather Service office in Flagstaff AZ.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 21 at 3:29PM MST until October 21 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: SNM:AVISO DE TORNADO hasta las 4:00 PM MST. Refugiese ahora. Consulte medios informativos

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: Servicio Nacional de Meteorologia: AVISO DE TORNADO en efecto hasta las 4:00 PM MST. Busque refugio ahora en un sotano o en el interior de un cuarto en el nivel mas bajo de un edificio seguro. Si esta al aire libre, en una casa movil, o en un vehiculo, debe ir al edificio seguro mas cercano y protegerse de proyectiles. Consulte los medios informativos.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 5:30 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 530 PM MST /630 PM MDT/.

* At 228 PM MST /328 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch
of rain has fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5
inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly. Flood waters flowing in from the
Moenkopi Wash are also emptying into the Little Colorado River near
Cameron at this time which will elevate water levels in the warning
area.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Colorado River Navajo Tribal Park and Salt Trail Canyon.

This includes the following highways...
the Colorado River near mile marker 62. State Route 64 near mile
marker 282...and between mile markers 285 and 286.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Blue Water Base Camp, Old Fish Camp Site and Above LCR Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Blue Water Base Camp.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Colorado River, Moenkopi Wash, Bekihatso Wash, Sheep Wash
and Colorado River.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

Cameron at this time which will elevate water levels in the warning
area.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Colorado River Navajo Tribal Park and Salt Trail Canyon.

This includes the following highways...
the Colorado River near mile marker 62. State Route 64 near mile
marker 282...and between mile markers 285 and 286.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Blue Water Base Camp, Old Fish Camp Site and Above LCR Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Blue Water Base Camp.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Colorado River, Moenkopi Wash, Bekihatso Wash, Sheep Wash
and Colorado River.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 5:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 5:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Moenkopi Wash in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 500 PM MST /600 PM MDT/.

* At 226 PM MST /326 PM MDT/, a river gauge and tribal community
members have reported flooding of Moenkopi Wash. Water has reached
near the base of the Highway 264 bridge and will continue
downstream into the village of Moenkopi. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Moenkopi Wash.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Moenkopi Wash.

* For Moenkopi Wash at Moenkopi Wash Near Tuba City:
At 1:45pm MST /2:45pm MDT/ the stage was 31.82 feet.
Flood Stage is 27.0 feet.

Impacts:
At 27.0 feet: At 27.0 feet water begins to encroach on homes in lower
Moenkopi Village and floods crop fields along the river.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tuba City and Moenkopi.

This includes the following highways...
Highway 160 between mile markers 318 and 321. U.S. Highway 89 between
mile markers 476 and 478. State Route 264 between mile markers 323
and 324.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Begashibito Wash, Moenkopi Wash, Hamblin Wash, Little Colorado
River and Fivemile Wash.
info.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Moenkopi Wash. Severe debris flows can also be anticipated
across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in places. If
you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 400 PM MDT.

* At 104 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across Zion Canyon within Zion National Park. Up to 0.25
inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to
0.5 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons and
normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 21 at 11:32AM MST until October 21 at 11:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 11:45 AM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 11:45 AM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 1145 AM MST.

* At 1132 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a
tornado was located 6 miles west of Valle, or 30 miles south of
Grand Canyon Village, moving northeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Valle, Valle Airport and Red Butte Mountain.

This includes State Route 64 between mile markers 213 and 232.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 21 at 11:32AM MST until October 21 at 11:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: SNM:AVISO DE TORNADO hasta las 11:45 AM MST. Refugiese ahora. Consulte medios informativos

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: Servicio Nacional de Meteorologia: AVISO DE TORNADO en efecto hasta las 11:45 AM MST. Busque refugio ahora en un sotano o en el interior de un cuarto en el nivel mas bajo de un edificio seguro. Si esta al aire libre, en una casa movil, o en un vehiculo, debe ir al edificio seguro mas cercano y protegerse de proyectiles. Consulte los medios informativos.
