info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 11:02AM MST until October 21 at 3:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 3:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 3:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Moenkopi Wash in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 300 PM MST /400 PM MDT/.

* At 1102 AM MST /1202 PM MDT/, a river gauge on the Moenkopi Wash
reported a rapid rise of around 8 feet from thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Moenkopi Wash. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Moenkopi Wash.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Moenkopi Wash.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Moenkopi.

This includes the following highways...
Highway 160 between mile markers 318 and 321. U.S. Highway 89 between
mile markers 476 and 478. State Route 264 between mile markers 323
and 324.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Colorado River, Begashibito Wash, Fivemile Wash, Moenkopi
Wash and Hamblin Wash.
info.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Moenkopi Wash. Severe debris flows can also be anticipated
across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in places. If
you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 945 AM MST.

* At 922 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Downtown Flagstaff, or over Flagstaff, moving
north at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
East Flagstaff, Doney Park, Timberline, Downtown Flagstaff, Fort
Valley, Fernwood, Pioneer Valley, Wupatki Trails, Pine Mountain
Estates, Sunset Crater Volcano National Monument, Northern Arizona
University, Country Club, Sunnyside, Railroad Springs, Cheshire,
Coconino Estates, Pine Canyon and Flagstaff Ranch.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between mile markers 193 and 204. Interstate 17 near
mile marker 339. U.S. Highway 89 between mile markers 419 and 432.
Route 66 between mile markers 194 and 204. Highway 180 between mile
markers 217 and 219.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Bonito Campground, Woody Mountain Campground, O'Leary Group
Campground, Ponderosa Trails Park, Thorpe Park, Wheeler Park,
Foxglenn Park, Buffalo Park, McPherson Park, Bushmaster Park and
Picture Canyon Preserve.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 945 AM MST.

* At 922 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Downtown Flagstaff, or over Flagstaff, moving
north at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
East Flagstaff, Doney Park, Timberline, Downtown Flagstaff, Fort
Valley, Fernwood, Pioneer Valley, Wupatki Trails, Pine Mountain
Estates, Sunset Crater Volcano National Monument, Northern Arizona
University, Country Club, Sunnyside, Railroad Springs, Cheshire,
Coconino Estates, Pine Canyon and Flagstaff Ranch.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between mile markers 193 and 204. Interstate 17 near
mile marker 339. U.S. Highway 89 between mile markers 419 and 432.
Route 66 between mile markers 194 and 204. Highway 180 between mile
markers 217 and 219.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Bonito Campground, Woody Mountain Campground, O'Leary Group
Campground, Ponderosa Trails Park, Thorpe Park, Wheeler Park,
Foxglenn Park, Buffalo Park, McPherson Park, Bushmaster Park and
Picture Canyon Preserve.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 945 AM MST.

* At 909 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 5 miles northwest of Forest Highlands, or 9 miles
southwest of Flagstaff, moving north at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
East Flagstaff, Downtown Flagstaff, Fort Valley, Forest Highlands,
Bellemont, Camp Navajo, Northern Arizona University, Sunnyside,
Railroad Springs, Cheshire, Coconino Estates, Flagstaff Ranch,
Riordan Mansion State Historic Park, Mt Elden Estates, Pine Del,
Arizona Snowbowl and Riordan.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between mile markers 188 and 195. Interstate 17 between
mile markers 338 and 339. Route 66 between mile markers 192 and 197.
State Route 89A between mile markers 394 and 398. Highway 180 between
mile markers 217 and 226.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Woody Mountain Campground, Fort Tuthill Campground, Ponderosa Trails
Park, Thorpe Park, Wheeler Park, Buffalo Park and McPherson Park.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued October 21 at 8:18AM MST until October 21 at 8:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 8:45 AM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 8:45 AM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 845 AM MST.

* At 818 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Jerome, or 8 miles west of Cottonwood, moving
north at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Clarkdale, Jerome, Jerome State Historic Park, Sycamore Canyon
Wilderness, Parsons Spring, Sycamore Canyon and Woodchute Mountain.

This includes State Route 89A between mile markers 338 and 348.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Parsons Spring.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

info.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 1115 AM MDT.

* At 815 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.25 and 0.5 inches of
rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park and Springdale.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 6:15 AM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 615 AM MST.

* At 541 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Bellemont, or 11 miles northwest of Flagstaff,
moving northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Fort Valley, Bellemont, Government Prairie, Inner Basin, Arizona
Snowbowl, Saddle Mountain, Humphreys Peak, Agassiz Peak, Kachina
Peaks Wilderness, Lava River Cave and Wing Mountain.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between mile markers 182 and 186. U.S. Highway 89
between mile markers 432 and 435. Highway 180 between mile markers
225 and 240.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lockett Meadow Campground and Locket Meadow Campground.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Tornadoes are difficult to observe at night. Take cover now!

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 5:45 AM MST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 5:45 AM MST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 545 AM MST.

* At 522 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Perkinsville, or 18 miles northwest of Cottonwood,
moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Perkinsville and J.D. Dam Lake.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Tornadoes are difficult to observe at night. Take cover now!

Forks.

info.senderName: NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
info.description:
TOREPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Central Luna County in southwestern New Mexico...

* Until 615 PM MDT.

* At 550 PM MDT, a confirmed tornado was located 8 miles west of
Deming, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Damaging tornado and golf ball size hail.

SOURCE...Emergency management confirmed tornado.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* The tornado will be near...
Deming around 555 PM MDT.
info.instruction:
To repeat, a tornado is on the ground. TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a
basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy
building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in
a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect
yourself from flying debris.

IpawsArchivedAlerts.originalMessage: AS-KS-d4f8b359-e71d-4bc5-a132-b894d5f1f0fekenji.brooks@sedgwick.gov2026-10-19T09:43:53-06:00ActualAlert011903 v1.157.0.1PublicIPAWSv1.0en-USOtherAdministrative MessageUnknownUnknownUnknownSAMEADR2026-10-19T09:43:53-06:002026-10-19T10:43:53-06:00Sedgwick CountySedgwick County testing outdoor warning devicesSedgwick County Emergency Management will be testing the Outdoor Warning Sirens at Noon Today. Sedgwick County outdoor warning sirens are tested every Monday at Noon, except Holidays and when threatening weather is present. Today we will be testing the Alert mode, for one minute. The Alert Mode is a steady tone used for Tornado warning, The Attack Mode is a classic rise and fall sound used for Air Attack Warning in times of war. Outdoor warning sirens are designed to be an early warning device primarily for persons who are outside away from the television and or radio. Remember, when the outdoor warning sirens sound, Take cover, Tune in to local media, Take action.Emergency Management officials highly recommend citizens keep a NOAA weather radio in their homes, preferably in the bedroom, with a tone alert for those times when you are not monitoring public media. This broadcast originates from Sedgwick County Emergency Management located at seven fourteen North Main, Wichita Kansas. WPMQ three ninety one. info.headline: Sedgwick County testing outdoor warning devices
info.description: Sedgwick County Emergency Management will be testing the Outdoor Warning Sirens at Noon Today. Sedgwick County outdoor warning sirens are tested every Monday at Noon, except Holidays and when threatening weather is present. Today we will be testing the Alert mode, for one minute. The Alert Mode is a steady tone used for Tornado warning, The Attack Mode is a classic rise and fall sound used for Air Attack Warning in times of war. Outdoor warning sirens are designed to be an early warning device primarily for persons who are outside away from the television and or radio. Remember, when the outdoor warning sirens sound, Take cover, Tune in to local media, Take action.
info.instruction: Emergency Management officials highly recommend citizens keep a NOAA weather radio in their homes, preferably in the bedroom, with a tone alert for those times when you are not monitoring public media. This broadcast originates from Sedgwick County Emergency Management located at seven fourteen North Main, Wichita Kansas. WPMQ three ninety one. No action required test only.

parameter.value: GDOT:75S I-285 N/S CLOSED EXITS 16 -15. CALL 511 or go to https://www.gaalert.com

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value:
GDOT: All lanes on I-285 northbound and southbound between S. Atlanta Road (exit 16) and SR 280/S Cobb Drive (exit 15) are closed in the cities of Atlanta and Smyrna, Fulton County until 5 a.m. on Monday, October 19.  All traffic approaching the closures will be detoured to use I-75, I-75/I-85 Connector and I-20
. CALL 511 or go to https://www.gaalert.com

info.description: Motorists who use this segment of I-285 should make plans to allow significant additional travel time during the closures, or to plan alternate routes. GDOT strongly urges motorists to rely on the 511GA app or call 511 as the primary source for real-time traffic conditions and lane closure details. Drivers should exercise caution in and around work zones, follow signage guidance, reduce speed, and avoid distractions behind the wheel.

info.headline: Extreme Wind Warning issued October 18 at 3:26AM ChST until October 18 at 5:30AM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: EXTREME WIND WARNING this area til 5:30 AM ChST. Take shelter now.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: An EXTREME WIND WARNING is in effect for this area for the immediate danger of life-threatening winds til 5:30 AM ChST. Take cover NOW in an interior room of a sturdy building, away from windows. Protect your head from flying debris. Do NOT go out in the calm of the hurricane eye! Winds will quickly become dangerous again.

info.description:
EWWGUM

The National Weather Service in Tiyan Guam has issued a

* Extreme Wind Warning for...
Southern Guam in Guam...

* Until 530 AM ChST.

* At 326 AM ChST, Andersen AFB Doppler radar indicated extreme
winds, associated with the northern eyewall of Typhoon Champi,
were moving onshore from Talofofo southward, moving west at 15
mph. THIS IS AN EXTREMELY DANGEROUS AND LIFE-THREATENING SITUATION!

* Locations impacted include...
Talofofo, Inarajan, Merizo, Santa Rita, and Umatac.
info.instruction:
Destructive winds of 115 to 135 mph will spread across far southern
Guam, producing swaths of significant to catastrophic damage,
particularly to non-concrete structures.

TAKE COVER NOW! The safest place to be during a major typhoon
passage is in a reinforced interior room away from windows. If you
are not in a fully-concrete structure, get under a table or other
piece of sturdy furniture. Use mattresses, blankets or pillows to
cover your head and body. Remain in place through the passage of
these life-threatening conditions.
